A Hapan vessel, '''Sharmok 718''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] utilized by the [[New Jedi Order]] during the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] from the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. In opposition, the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]] deployed a wing of antiquated [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray twelve-jays]] to ambush the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[academy]], while the Jedi evacuation effort was covered by four wings of [[Hapan]] [[Miy'til starfighter]]s.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

Separated from the other [[Starship/Legends|transports]] during the battle, the Sith managed to board and rig the Sharmok 718 with [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] explosives. The transport then feigned communication difficulties and headed for the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapan]] [[Dragon Queen II|flagship]] in an attempt to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]], whom they believed would give birth to a [[Allana Djo Solo|Jedi queen]] capable of preventing their [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|rule]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. However, the Jedi and Hapans noticed the Sharmok behaving in a suspicious manner, and Djo ultimately ordered the Hapan [[Volgh Squadron]] to open fire and disable the vessel. Left adrift and with the Hapans preparing to board, Sharmok 718 exploded, destroying Volgh Squadron and killing the hundreds still aboard.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

After the explosion, the Hapans launched a search for possible survivors, though [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] doubted any would be found, suspecting the Sith had already killed the evacuees&mdash;including over two dozen Jedi&mdash;during the boarding action and those killed in the explosion were members of a Sith boarding party.<ref name="Apocalypse" />
